name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme
description: Credit-linked subsidy programme to generate continuous and sustainable self-employment opportunities through establishment of micro-enterprises in manufacturing and services sectors.
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
target_beneficiaries: Individuals aged 18 years and above intending to establish micro-enterprises
Self Help Groups (SHGs) and institutions registered under Societies Registration Act
benefits: Government subsidy (margin money) of 15% to 35% of project cost (up to Rs. 50 lakh for manufacturing and Rs. 20 lakh for services), with beneficiary own contribution of only 5% to 10%.

source_evidence.statement: Administered by the Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises through Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC) as single nodal agency.
source_evidence.issuing_authority: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises

source_evidence.statement: Central sector credit-linked employment generation scheme active across all rural and urban areas of India.
source_evidence.issuing_authority: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises

source_evidence.statement: Any individual above 18 years of age without prior government loan default.
source_evidence.issuing_authority: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises

source_evidence.statement: Margin money subsidy of 25% to 35% in rural areas and 15% to 25% in urban areas on bank loans up to Rs. 50 lakh for manufacturing and Rs. 20 lakh for services.
source_evidence.issuing_authority: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
source_evidence.citation: Section 4, Quantum and Nature of Financial Assistance

source_evidence.statement: Application submission handled end-to-end on KVIC PMEGP e-Portal at kviconline.gov.in.
source_evidence.issuing_authority: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises

source_evidence.statement: Active nationwide credit linkage with more than 8 lakh micro-enterprises assisted across the country.

eligibility_criteria.limitations: Existing units or units that have already availed government subsidy under any other central/state scheme are not eligible.

required_documents.title: Detailed Project Report (DPR)
required_documents.description: Business project proposal outlining manufacturing/service activity, capital expenditure and working capital requirements.

required_documents.title: Educational Qualification Certificate
required_documents.description: Minimum Class VIII pass certificate for projects exceeding Rs. 10 lakh in manufacturing or Rs. 5 lakh in services.

required_documents.title: PAN Card
required_documents.description: Income Tax Permanent Account Number card.
